default/30637.htm.text: Summoner Belthus That is my shadow Turen over there, so don't touch him. Ah, excuse me for my late introduction. I am Summoner Belthus. I am here to train my animals in the Cruma Marshlands.

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30637-01.html.text: Summoner Belthus: Oh really? Are you here to train your creature? You should challenge my Shadow Turen... I'm really glad you showed up! I was beginning to get bored. Look over here... Don't you think this is a perfect place for a battle!

links.text: "I challenge you to a Summoner's Duel."

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30637-05.html.text: Summoner Belthus: Savor the taste, sweet Turen, next time you may drink more blood... My friend, your control has promise but you still need much practice. Most importantly you didn't trust your creature's instincts. You must not be overbearing in your desire to win. This creates stress and reduced…

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30637-06.html.text: Summoner Belthus: Cheating will get you nowhere! For that, you shall forfeit your Arcana Card.

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30637-10.html.text: Summoner Belthus: Hey, why are you still here? Am I am the only Summoner who will fight you? To pass this trial you must defeat 6 other Summoners... Good luck, and I hope you become a real Summoner soon. It is very humiliating to say that I lost to an apprentice Summoner...

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30637-02.html.text: Summoner Belthus: As much as I would like to fight right now, it is impossible until you present an Arcana Card... In the Town of Dion there is a woman named Lara that creates and sells adequate Arcana Cards.

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30637-03.html.text: Summoner Belthus I suppose you know the rules? The first attack shall be made by summoned creatures! No intervention by the Summoners is allowed! Is that clear? Are you ready for battle?

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30637-04.html.text: Summoner Belthus: I accept your Arcana Card of apprenticeship! Your creature is allowed the first attack. Turen is waiting!
